dataset.title: Huge Stock Market Dataset (all U.S. stocks and ETFs)
dataset.upstream_source: Not stated by the uploader ("This dataset belongs to me")
dataset.coverage: Daily, 1962-01-02 to 2017-11-10 (most series much shorter); research window 2005-02-25 to 2017-11-10
dataset.markets: NYSE, NASDAQ, NYSE MKT stocks and ETFs
dataset.adjustment: Prices adjusted for splits and dividends by the uploader (back-adjusted); no raw prices
dataset.timestamps: Trade date only; FLO assumes availability at 16:30 America/New_York on that date
dataset.use_restrictions: Research and education inside FLO. Do not redistribute the data; upstream terms are unknown.
known_limitations: SURVIVORSHIP BIAS: every stock series reaches 2017 (no series ends before 2017-01-01); companies that delisted earlier are absent
Back-adjusted price levels embed later dividends and splits; only returns and volume-based features are used
SPY history in this dataset starts 2005-02-25, which bounds the benchmark window
The archive ships a byte-identical duplicate copy under Data/; ingestion deduplicates it by checksum
